# Olivabot

> Olivabot B.V. (KVK 94493200, Amsterdam) does edge AI, embedded firmware, and robot learning, plus studies and prototypes. Email services@olivabot.com.

Olivabot is a Dutch BV. Work is remote from a laptop, invoiced from the Netherlands, for clients in the EU. We do not use LinkedIn. Gibbon Bot is our own research robot and does not work yet; it is not a product for sale.

## Hire

- [Edge AI Amsterdam](https://olivabot.com/en/services/edge-ai.html): model on the device, €6,000–10,000, two to three weeks, half before the work starts
- [Firmware Amsterdam](https://olivabot.com/en/services/firmware.html): ESP32, nRF, BLE, battery, €6,000–10,000, two to three weeks
- [Robot learning Amsterdam](https://olivabot.com/en/services/robot-learning.html): one behavior in simulation, policy and setup, €8,000–15,000, about three weeks
- [Contact](https://olivabot.com/en/contact.html): email services@olivabot.com
- [Services](https://olivabot.com/en/services.html): the three offers above, plus studies, prototypes, and grove work
- [Feasibility](https://olivabot.com/en/services/feasibility.html): a look at whether an idea can work, before anyone builds it
- [Prototypes](https://olivabot.com/en/services/prototype.html): a first version, enough to learn from
- [Consulting](https://olivabot.com/en/services/consulting.html): a conversation, then a written note on what to do next

## Projects

- [Projects](https://olivabot.com/en/projects.html): Madglove Sense, Mycofarming Mycosense, Gibbon Bot, and research
- [Madglove Sense](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/madglove-sense.html): sensors and firmware for a rehabilitation glove
- [Mycosense](https://olivabot.com/en/projects/mycosense.html): LoRaWAN monitoring for Mycofarming
